description: This file implements backend APIs for IPv6 Routing Data Model in the COSA (Cisco Open Service Architecture) framework. It manages IPv6 rapid deployment interface entries including creation, initialization, registration, addition, deletion, and cleanup, with interactions with persistent storage and data model layers.

classes.name: COSA_DATAMODEL_IPV6RD
classes.description: Data structure representing the IPv6RD (IPv6 Rapid Deployment) data model, including configuration flags, list of interfaces, and related metadata.

classes.name: COSA_DML_IPV6RD_IF
classes.description: Represents an IPv6RD interface entry with attributes like InstanceNumber, Alias, and configuration parameters.

classes.name: COSA_CONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: A context object linking data model entries with their corresponding registry or configuration folder objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6rdInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the IPv6RD data model, loads existing entries, and sets up the internal list and registry folders.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaIPv6rdCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates an instance of the IPv6RD data model object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6rdRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and removes all IPv6RD interface entries and frees associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6rdIfRegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Registers and retrieves information about IPv6RD interfaces from the persistent storage into the internal list.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6rdIfRegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Adds a new IPv6RD interface record into the registry and updates the internal structures accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaIPv6rdIfRegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes the specified IPv6RD interface record from the registry and updates internal structures.
